blocks.text: Mission BC Open Houses | Upcoming Open House Listings

parts.t: Browse all upcoming open houses in Mission, BC, including houses, townhomes, condos, and new listings. This page is updated regularly with the latest open house dates, times, prices, and MLS® listings, making it easy to plan your weekend and compare properties in one place. Whether you’re a first-time buyer, upgrading, or just watching the market, open houses are a great way to explore Mission neighbourhoods and current market value. For more information on any property or to book a private showing, contact Jared Gibbons today.

Mission's open houses showcase why this Fraser Valley community attracts buyers seeking natural beauty, outdoor recreation, and exceptional value. This weekend's events offer opportunities to explore diverse properties from affordable condos to executive homes, lakefront cottages to rural acreages—experiencing neighborhoods and lifestyles firsthand.

Attending open houses here lets you discover Mission's unique character with its small-town atmosphere, stunning mountain and river views, plus recreation access that defines the area. You'll meet listing agents, ask questions about properties and communities, and get immediate feel for layouts and finishes beyond what photos convey. Many buyers find unexpected opportunities, learn about areas like Hatzic lakefront or downtown heritage properties they hadn't considered, and narrow searches significantly through strategic touring. The casual weekend format makes exploring comfortable whether you're seriously house hunting or beginning your Mission research. Planning your tour? Contact me for this week's complete open house schedule including times, addresses, and property details throughout Mission. See
Can't find what you're looking for? Jared can search the full MLS® for you.
